close_reason: Extended the tests module preamble with explicit 'do not generate fixtures programmatically' guidance and an audit-trail note about the figure-of-record citations. Cross-referenced workspace AGENTS.md Test Integrity and PLAN.md §Round-trip test policy. The bead's defensive intent (defend the cited-figure fixtures against a 'reduce repetition' PR) is now visible to anyone touching the test module. No code change. 58 tests pass; cargo doc -D warnings clean. Commit pending.
description: Every round-trip test cites the RFC 9553 figure number it was copied from (lib.rs:1184 'Figure 16', :1218 'Figure 21', :1228 'Figure 22', :1242 'Figure 23', etc.). The fixtures are hand-typed from the IETF document, not generated by the code under test. This satisfies the workspace 'No test that uses the code under test as its own oracle' rule and the project AGENTS.md Test Integrity section. A future contributor refactoring the test module might be tempted to generate the JSON fixtures programmatically (e.g. T::default() then serialize) to reduce repetition — defend against that PR; the cited-figure fixtures are the entire point of the oracle. The RFC citation in the test name also helps a reviewer cross-check: when RFC 9553 errata land, the figures-of-record are the things to re-check first.
title: Test fixtures hardcoded from RFC 9553 figure numbers — independent oracle
